args.requirement: Chat Completions requests (URLs ending in /chat/completions) must skip the Codex custom-tool translation, passing the body through unchanged with codexCompatibility=null. Before this fix, translateCodexCustomToolsForCopilot was called on all writable Copilot requests including Chat Completions routes, causing it to reject valid Chat Completions custom tools with "Unsupported Responses custom tool '(unknown)'".
